sampleScene: A quiet domestic room, open window, chair, plant and daylight. Fictional demonstration content only.
purpose: Thirty visual-style demonstrations, packaged as five six-cell sheets. The plugin shows one cell per template using an SVG viewport. These are generated style samples, not third-party artwork or guarantees for future model output.
generationConstraints: Two columns by three rows, no gutters. One exact Chinese headline per cell, no other text. Deliberately different typography, composition and medium for every cell.
editorialCleanup: Built-in imagegen removed an unwanted artist-like seal from the Chinese ink panel.
encoding: WebP quality 87; source pixels are not cropped, recolored or repainted during packaging.
